'''Mister.Six My Kind Of Scum''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Mister.Six]]
* '''Published:''' 19 March 2005 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS8]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive|JPSD-D-mykindofscum.gif|label=My Kind Of Scum}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Twi'lek Advisor (V) (Virtual Set 8)|VS8O-45-Twilek_Advisor.png|label=Twi'lek Advisor (V)}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Scum And Villainy|JP-D-scumandvillainy.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' My Kind Of Scum
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS8 MKOS Mister.Six DS 2005 GPN.txt |Download]] (omits Twi'lek Advisor (V), Jabba's Influence (V), URoRRuR'R'R (V), Djas Puhr (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

Very similar in design to my Chandra-Fan deck. Has a better success rate but all helpful tips welcome for improvement.

The published list has 61 cards.

== Notes ==

* Qty 61 as published (no section counts). Scum And Villainy is listed in Starting and again under Effects: 2 as posted.
* Starting: Twi'lek Advisor (V) (VS8, a Starting Interrupt) with Scum And Villainy, Den Of Thieves, Jabba's Influence (V) and Power Of The Hutt; Well Guarded is also in Starting.
* Desilijic Tattoo is unmarked, so the printed card. Posted 'Mandalorian Armour' dested Mandalorian Armor.
* Original-era (V) slips: Twi'lek Advisor and URoRRuR'R'R (VS8), Jabba's Influence (VS6), Djas Puhr (VS2).

== Strategy ==

STRATEGY

It all pretty much speaks for itself.

First Turn ( 5 force) Play Scum & Villainy from hand. Use Jabba’s Palace to grab the Audience Chamber – having a look for Jabba and pull him with the locations game text.

In subsequent turns I continue to pull locations and aliens to flip my Objective (Usually done at the latest on my second turn.)

I pursue force drains with the locations and the Expand The Empire – baiting my opponent in and beating up anybody who comes along with a continuous flow of Chevins backed by leaders and bounty hunters.

Also; Boba, Jodo, Mandalorian Armour, All Wrapped Up and the Dungeon keep invaders at bay and retrieve a little force. If the pressure is on at Tatooine sites I like to zip around on the Skiffs using reacts for tight situations and then regroup.

Xizor, Guri and Chokk are a little hit squad that I usually arm with the Naboo Blasters and interfere with my opponent’s agenda on other planet sites. If I need to probe or take to the skies I load Xizor and Guri up on their ships.

Jabba’s Twerps and Abyssin Ornament provide a little life boost if necessary.

It’s got a 50% loss rate at the moment but I can’t find the weak links – like my other deck it seems good on paper but I can’t quite get it to work. Any helpful suggestions appreciated.

Hi Cam, thanks for the comments.

I thought about Abyssins but I only  have 1 X MYO which I felt wasn't enought to take real advantage of the objective. (I like cancelling destiny draws; I have very aggressive oppenents!) I also figured the Objective could re-cycle Chevins just as well as Abyssins game text. Any thoughts?

Xizor, Guri and their matching ships are usually enough to go probing / EBO battling but I'll look at matching ships; I've only just discovered (V) cards so am only just absorbing them!

I was using Lars Moisture Farm for it's game text (+1 Weapon destinies and +1 force drains.)And throwing an Expand The Empire on it but I'll take a look and give the barge a go - I've just been lucky so far and drawn it!
